properties.name: When a mirrored product is superseded, its withdrawn judgments are KEPT and marked superseded, the reasoning links into them stay, and every decision that rested on them reads reason-lost until it is re-grounded
properties.source: Anthony Sligar (who:ajs), dev_reflow2 hub session, 2026-10-22, split-capstone trial
properties.statement:
Anthony, 2026-10-22 ("Go with your recommendations on all 3"), on the split-capstone trial's finding.

MEASURED (fact:the-split-capstone-ran-on-0-90-0-and-a-refreshed-mirror-erases-the-reasons-a-decision-lost-2026-10-22): when acquisition re-mirrored Intel's KESTREL-ASSESS v2 surface, the refresh DELETED v1's withdrawn judgments KJ1–KJ4 with no snapshot or change event. It also silently dropped every local edge into them: the PREMISE_OF reasoning edges, CONSUMES, CALIBRATED_AGAINST, DOCUMENTS and ASKS_ABOUT. Afterwards reasons_lost read 0, propagate_from on the withdrawn ids returned unknown_seeds, and the pin still named v1. The re-mirror guard counted DEPENDS_ON and ASKS_ABOUT but not PREMISE_OF. The one-design capstone (10-19) did report the lost reasons. Within the producer's design, `replaces` left the old judgments published, and a superseded judgment read "contested", not superseded.

WHAT IT ASKS:
(1) A refreshed mirror never deletes a node the new surface withdraws. It keeps the node, marks it superseded (naming the surface version that withdrew it), and records a snapshot and a change event.
(2) Local edges into a withdrawn node stay, and the refresh reports each one.
(3) Every decision or claim whose premise was withdrawn reads reason-lost in loop_status and reasoning_report, and propagate_from can seed from the withdrawn id, until the owner re-grounds it or lets it go.
(4) The re-mirror guard counts PREMISE_OF, and every other local reasoning edge, as a dependency.
(5) A judgment superseded by `replaces` reads superseded (not contested) and stops being published.

Built in the queued reflow2 PR "proofs and arguments read right". Session: https://claude.ai/code/session_019Xbw6PG9mXJiU2Sb421fnq
